## Introduction to Inverse Problems

Inverse problems involve inferring model parameters from observed data. In geosciences, this includes determining subsurface properties from surface measurements.

## Implicit Neural Representations (INR)

Implicit Neural Representations use neural networks to represent continuous functions, enabling compact and differentiable representations of complex fields.
